decision: host the bots on aojdevmac-m5 (M5 Pro, 64 GB, Xcode 27.1, OrbStack, logged-in GUI session)
why: Ossie named the m5 mac mini; GUI session needed for the SwiftUI app
evidence: ssh probe: who shows console login

decision: bots run Claude Code on claude-opus-5-5 through CLIProxyAPI on the mini with new key CLIPROXYAPI_KEY_CUABOTS
why: no Anthropic API key needed; uses the Claude plan; dedicated key so it can be revoked alone
evidence: BWS CLIPROXYAPI_KEY_CUABOTS; mini cliproxyapi.conf backup bak-*; test call returned 'proxy ok'

decision: work in fork AojdevStudio/cua, branch ossie/selfhost, clone at aojdevmac-m5:~/code/cua
why: patches (bundle id, tailnet pairing, proxy env) need a home; upstream stays untouched

decision: iPhone reaches the bot over Tailscale, not the cua.ai relay
why: relay cannot publish a bot Space yet (upstream gap) and needs a cua.ai account; iphone183 is on the tailnet

decision: registered bundle id studio.aoj.cuabots (ASC id 35R987GD8G), matching the studio.aoj.* prefix of Ossie's other apps
why: TestFlight needs a bundle id on Ossie's team

decision: app record cannot be created by agent: ASC API refuses apps CREATE, no Xcode Apple ID, no live ASC browser session
why: creating it needs Ossie's Apple ID 2FA; will finish build, signing and upload script so his step is one click plus one command
evidence: ASC 403 'apps does not allow CREATE'; Chrome cookies have no myacinfo

decision: set OrbStack app.start_at_login true
why: local Spaces need Docker after a reboot; OrbStack, never Docker Desktop

decision: patched Keyvault.swift, WorkViews.swift, Sheets.swift to the current KvItem fields (domain, key, app_display)
why: the sample did not compile against the staged Cua Spaces export: KvItem has no label, account or site

decision: persist the agent event cursor per run ID in the store state
why: after a restart the app polled from 0 and showed Obi's last reply again
evidence: commit 68765986; testRestartDoesNotRepeatAFinishedTurn failed before, passes after; 23 tests pass

decision: add SelfHost.swift: CUA_BOTS_SEED creates Obi once, CUA_BOTS_SHOW_COMPUTER opens its computer, SIGUSR1 writes a snapshot and the pairing links
why: a headless Mac has nobody to click New bot, and ssh screencapture fails without a Screen Recording grant

decision: snapshot with ScreenCaptureKit SCShareableContent.currentProcess, matched to the main NSWindow
why: screencapture from ssh and from a launchd agent both fail: could not create image from display; the first snapshot caught a stream surface, so match by window number

decision: CUA_BOTS_PAIRING_HOST swaps 127.0.0.1 for aojdevmac-m5.tail3a79a5.ts.net in the pairing link, port kept
why: the phone needs a host it can reach; same port number keeps the forward rule simple

decision: forward spacesd with tailscale serve --tcp P to 127.0.0.1:P, reconciled on docker start and die events
why: cua-vmm publishes spacesd on 127.0.0.1 with a random host port; tailscale serve listens only on the tailnet; event driven, not polling
evidence: ossie/logs/proof/out-listeners.log: 127.0.0.1 and 100.98.3.78 only; out-reach.log: LAN refused

decision: run the app from ~/.local/share/cua-bots, copied by ossie/install-runtime.sh
why: the first deploy hung: bash blocked in open() on /Volumes/Lexar waiting on a Removable Volumes prompt nobody can click
evidence: bgjob deploy 1 health check failed; sample of bash in __open_nocancel; deploy 2 healthy

decision: bgjob com.obi.cua-bots: user scope, run_at_load, keep_alive, LimitLoadToSessionType Aqua, health pgrep CuaBots
why: bgjob has no GUI app type, but a gui/<uid> LaunchAgent with Aqua session type starts a windowed app at login

decision: read CLIPROXYAPI_KEY_CUABOTS with hush at start, BWS token from ~/.env
why: the key must never sit in a file or plist; launchd has no shell rc

decision: set CUA_TELEMETRY=0 for the app
why: capture.sh turns it off too; a personal self-host should not send usage data by default

decision: Obi's standing instructions come from the sample's own template with owner Ossie
why: the template already says You are Obi, Ossie's bot, a persistent assistant; no custom prompt needed
evidence: reply: I'm Obi (@ossie-obi), and I work for Ossie.

decision: did not reboot the M5 to test login start
why: a reboot would cut the parallel iOS agent's build on the same box
evidence: autoLoginUser aojadmin, FileVault Off, RunAtLoad true

decision: BotEngine.wake boots a stopped Space with spaces().start at launch, and a dead run is dropped so the next message starts one in the same Space
why: review finding: after a reboot bot-obi stayed Exited (restart policy no) and its run came back crashed

decision: bringUp keeps the bot's own Space instead of calling provision again
why: Spaces.create with reuse returns any healthy local Space, so a second bot could take Obi's (upstream gap, cua-spaces/src/spaces.rs reusable)

decision: save the event cursor only when a batch ends a turn
why: review finding: saving the live cursor mid-turn lost the reply text held in memory
evidence: testRestartMidTurnKeepsTheWholeReply failed with the live cursor, passes now

decision: stable tailnet port per bot (from 43211) in ~/.local/share/cua-bots/tailnet-ports, read by the app for the pairing link
why: Docker picks a new loopback port at every container start (32769, 32770, 32771, 32772 seen), which would force a re-pair after each reboot
evidence: out-roundtrip-reboot2.log: old link :43211 worked after loopback moved to 32772

decision: the forwarder touches only forwards listed in its state file and reconnects when the docker event stream ends
why: review findings: P to 127.0.0.1:P is not proof of ownership, and a dead event stream stopped all updates

decision: umask 077 in the launcher and a 0700 runtime dir
why: review finding: the pairing file holding the spacesd token was 0644

decision: CUA_BOTS_SHOW_COMPUTER opens the computer only after wake and once the pointer probe answers
why: after a reboot the first stream opened before the screen answered, and AppModel keeps the first stream it opens; reordering the bridge was tried first and did not help, so it was reverted

decision: left open: a container restart while the app keeps running (an OrbStack restart) still leaves the old run until the app relaunches
why: wake runs at launch only; a reboot relaunches the app, so the asked-for case is covered

decision: persist each run's last finished turn and skip events of settled turns on replay
why: review round 2: a batch with a finished turn and part of the next one left the cursor behind, so a restart repeated the reply and its actions; the page cursor is a byte offset, so the store settles by turn number
evidence: testRestartAfterABatchThatEndsMidTurnRepeatsNothing failed without the skip, passes now; 26 tests

decision: the forwarder retries every 30 s while a reconcile failed and otherwise waits on docker events
why: review round 2: a reconcile that failed with Tailscale down was never retried
result: VERIFIED: forward followed a container restart

decision: tell a read timeout from the end of the event stream by elapsed time
why: review round 3: macOS bash 3.2 returns 1 for both, so the reader broke after any quiet 30 s and a failed reconcile was never retried
evidence: ossie/logs/proof/out-forwarder-retry-before.log (no retry) and out-forwarder-retry.log (retry 31 s later, no events)
